tasks.label: Run current Java or C++ file
tasks.detail: Compile and run the active Java or C++ file without changing launch.json

linux.command: f="${relativeFile}"; case "$f" in *.java) fqn=$(printf '%s' "$f" | sed 's#^java/src/##; s#\.java$##; s#/#.#g'); mkdir -p build/java && javac -d build/java -sourcepath java/src "$f" && java -cp build/java "$fqn" ;; *.cpp) mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -g -Icpp/include "$f" -o "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}" && "./build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}" ;; *) echo "Unsupported file type: $f"; exit 1 ;; esac

windows.command: $src = '${relativeFile}'; if ($src.EndsWith('.java')) { $rel = $src -replace '^java[\\/]src[\\/]',''; $fqn = ($rel -replace '\.java$','') -replace '[\\/]','.'; if (!(Test-Path build/java)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory build/java | Out-Null }; javac -d build/java -sourcepath java/src $src; if ($?) { java -cp build/java $fqn }; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; if ($src.EndsWith('.cpp')) { if (!(Test-Path build)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory build | Out-Null }; g++ -std=c++14 -Wall -Wextra -g -Icpp/include $src -o build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe; if ($?) { & build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe }; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Error ('Unsupported file type: ' + $src); exit 1

tasks.label: C++: build & run current file
tasks.detail: Compile the open .cpp into build/ and run it (Windows: MinGW+PowerShell, Linux: g++)

windows.command: if (!(Test-Path build)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory build | Out-Null }; g++ -std=c++14 -Wall -Wextra -g -Icpp/include "${relativeFile}" -o "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe"; if ($?) { & "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" }

tasks.label: C++: build current file (debug)
tasks.detail: Compile the open .cpp with -g into build/ (no run) for debugging

windows.command: if (!(Test-Path build)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory build | Out-Null }; g++ -std=c++14 -Wall -Wextra -g -Icpp/include "${relativeFile}" -o "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe"
